ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Who feasts on deer in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the diagram is a food web, containing animal labels such as Deer, Wolverine, Skunk, Moose, Caribou, etc. Deer is located in the middle position toward the lower part of the diagram, and Wolverine is located above Deer. One can see an arrow from Deer pointing to Wolverine, with the arrow tip at Wolverine. Then reason: in a food web, arrows point from the organism being eaten to the predator; therefore, this arrow pointing to Wolverine indicates that Wolverine eats deer.
